comment: Not a good dude

This FYS was probably the easiest one. 2 long papers and a presentation and that's all. He assigns a lot of reading, but you don't usually have to do it. In class, it's a socratic exchange and participation is a big part of the grade.
Minimal reading. Typical Socratic exchange. He is a very understanding and nice professor, you will get to learn a lot in class. No tests, just two papers, and a presentation. Was a breeze for me.

Have to read to participate, which is a big part of the grade. Seems like he only sees positives in your commentary, but surprisingly tough grader. Only other graded materials were 2 essays (one was a long research paper) and a presentation. Grading scale is tough: A-: 94-95; A: 96-97; A+: 98-100. He does readily give back points on essays though.

Taylor is a sweetheart. He likes anything you say in class- can be a real stretch to a current event or something, so readings aren't crucial. All papers are on topics not in readings too. Tough grader on papers, but helps you when you meet with him and often boosts your grade. Got an A- without too much work, and enjoyed his niceness/enthusiasm

Students will have to learn how to write strong papers by themselves in his Seminar class. As papers compose most of class grades, meeting with him to review drafts is highly recommended. Discussion-wise, Taylor is very friendly and tries to see good points in everyone's comments. In short: Simply one of the nicest teachers here at Richmond.

He is the nicest teacher. He was really easy. You read the books and talk about them in class. Participation is part of your grade so read the books. The class was very discussion based, and he's very interested in what you have to say about a particular topic.
Such a great professor, he's helpful and interested in your opinions. Recommended!
Professor Taylor is outstanding. He truly cares about all of his students and he is willing to help students in any way possible. He has a good sense of humor and rewards critical thinking.
He is easily my favorite teacher here. Class was easy but interesting, and he is a super nice guy.

Best professor/class I have taken at UR.  He is extremely encouraging and a brilliant man. Course material is interesting in its own right but made better with his evocative questions and debate topics.  Can be a lot of work but you actually want to do the assignments.

Best professor I have had at UR.  Extremely smart, makes material engaging and gives current and practical examples.  Various forms of testing and grading so its not all papers or all tests and gives you a chance to do really well. Take this class! Taylor is encouraging and smart and you will learn alot.
A very brilliant and wonderful professor who is full of wisdom. A true gentleman and kindhearted person with class. A great access to the University of Richmond.
By far the best professor I have ever had!  I look forward to his class every week!
By far my favorite teacher at UR

Absolutely brilliant, extremely positive.  Best personality of any professor on campus.  Tons of interesting material, mostly discussion of cases.  Book is dense and not all that great but you still need to do the readings.  TAKE HIS CLASS!!!
Super sweet in class, TONS of varied experience and stories, makes participating really easy (and makes you feel SMART!)...don't underestimate him though, the guy is brilliant.

Awesome Prof.  Class entirely composed of discussion and debate.  Tests not too difficult as long as you studied what he says in class (Take good notes). Overall, one of the best professors that I've had at the university.

He is highly intelligent and overall a nice guy. Learned a lot in class. Book was not quite helpful though. If you like participating in intellectual discussions and enjoy debate, this class is for you. (Helpful tip: Listen and copy everything what he says, including comments taken from students. This will help a lot when taking exams. )
Best teacher I've had at Richmond, bar none

I thought he was a fabulous teacher.  He's got a ton of real life experience to draw from and he makes his class interactive and fun.  I had him for a 1 night a week class, which can often times drag on forever, but I always loved the class and it never felt as long as it way.  Great teacher!
Keeps and peeks your interest, invites class participation, full of "a ha" theories.
